ready: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader | grep -q 5090 && test -d /workspace/neural-landscape && ! pgrep -f simple_trainer >/dev/null && ! pgrep -f offline-render >/dev/null
script:
set -e
export DENO_INSTALL=$HOME/.deno
command -v $DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh -s -- -y >/dev/null 2>&1)
cd /workspace/neural-landscape
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE=1; timeout 60 git pull -q --ff-only || true
rm -rf artifacts/gt/flight-03
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --allow-net --allow-run --allow-env \
  --node-modules-dir=auto --unstable-webgpu tools/offline-render.ts \
  --flight=flight-03 --fps=4 --width=960 --height=540 --gt --gt-ss=2 --no-cache \
  --output=artifacts/video/preview-rgb.mp4
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --node-modules-dir=auto tools/gt-viz-frames.ts artifacts/gt/flight-03
$DENO_INSTALL/bin/deno run --allow-read --allow-write --node-modules-dir=auto tools/gt-instances.ts artifacts/gt/flight-03
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -framerate 4 -i artifacts/gt/flight-03/viz-depth/depth_%04d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p artifacts/video/preview-depth.mp4
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -framerate 4 -i artifacts/gt/flight-03/normal_%04d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p artifacts/video/preview-normal.mp4
ffmpeg -nostdin -y -v error -framerate 4 -i artifacts/gt/flight-03/viz-instance/instance_%04d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p artifacts/video/preview-instance.mp4
python3 /workspace/pod-runtime/pod/hf_upload.py --repo miguelemosreverte/alambique-datasets --prefix preview/kazbek-flight03-ss2 \
  artifacts/video/preview-rgb.mp4 artifacts/video/preview-depth.mp4 artifacts/video/preview-normal.mp4 artifacts/video/preview-instance.mp4
echo PREVIEW-SS2-DONE
